timeline.summary: Quadrant Future Tek filed the CARE Ratings monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 on May 12, 2026, showing unutilised IPO proceeds and delays in electronic interlocking capex.
On May 20, 2026, Quadrant Future Tek filed a writ petition in the Punjab & Haryana High Court challenging the Regional Director's order on private placement compliance.
On May 26, 2026, Quadrant Future Tek announced receipt of RDSO permission to commence passenger trials for its KAVACH 4.0 Automatic Train Protection system.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹56.56 Cr, net profit ₹1.14 Cr.
Quadrant Future Tek released its Q4FY26 investor presentation highlighting a 70% QoQ revenue increase and RDSO approval for KAVACH 4.0 passenger trials.
